title: Living Room Blanket Mountain
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Gather two chairs, a bedsheet, and three couch cushions.
Drape the sheet over the chairs to make a secret tunnel.
Crawl inside with a flashlight and tell one terrible monster joke.

title: Wall Shadow Puppets
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Turn off the bedroom light and aim the bedside lamp at a bare wall.
Make a barking dog with your fingers: thumb down, four fingers up.
Have the shadow dog give them a goodnight lick on the nose.

title: Five-Minute Cloud Safari
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Lie flat on your backs on a blanket or grass.
Look straight up and find the first animal hiding in the clouds.
Take three deep breaths of fresh air together.

title: Pots and Spoons Parade
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Hand them a wooden spoon and an upside-down steel pot.
Tap a slow heartbeat rhythm together: 1 - 2, 1 - 2.
March around the kitchen table in a two-person parade.

title: Rain Boots Puddle Splash
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Put on rain boots and jackets.
Step outside to find the biggest puddle on the sidewalk.
Count to three and jump into the center with both feet.

title: Two-Sentence Whisper Story
author: Content & Family Experience Lead
steps: Tuck the blankets up to their chin.
Whisper sentence one: 'Once upon a time there was a tiny owl who loved bedtime.'
Ask them to whisper sentence two before closing their eyes.
